axes.name: Flow
axes.location_description: Horizontal axis of the top Performance Curve panel; its tick labels and axis title are not shown. Flow and unit are inferred from alignment with the lower panel.
axes.ignore_reason: No visible tick values, so this axis cannot be calibrated independently; use the labeled lower-panel flow axis.

axes.name: Power
axes.location_description: Left vertical axis of the top Performance Curve panel, labeled POWER, with [hp] shown near the upper-left of the plot.

axes.name: Flow
axes.location_description: Horizontal axis along the bottom of the lower panel, labeled FLOW [l/s].

axes.name: Head
axes.location_description: Left vertical axis of the lower panel; the [m] unit and scale are visible, while the axis title is partly cropped at the left edge.

axes.name: NPSHR
axes.location_description: Inner right vertical axis of the lower panel, along the plot border, labeled NPSHR [m] with a 0–15 scale.

axes.name: Efficiency
axes.location_description: Outer right vertical axis of the lower panel, offset to the right of the plot border, labeled EFF [%] with a 0–70 scale.

warnings: The top panel has no visible horizontal-axis title or tick values; its flow identity and unit are inferred from alignment with the lower panel.
The lower-panel left-axis title is partly cropped, though its [m] unit and scale are visible.
